title: "Feature: Activity Recognition/Awards Tracking"

## Problem
No way to track awards or recognition for activities.

## Solution
- Add recognition/award field to activities (First, Second, Participation, etc.)
- Display recognition in activity details

## Acceptance Criteria
- Recognition/awards can be added and viewed for each activity
